decisions.reason: The source changes only the separately modeled book-cover cropping rule. It does not alter the landing page's general content, copy, hero structure, or responsive-layout rules.
Making the landing-page book cover fully visible does not change any FAQ content or editorial rule.
The source concerns the cropping of the landing-page book-cover image and does not change About-page content.
The book-cover visibility correction does not change the current or planned product name.
The landing-page image-cropping change has no effect on email authentication or dashboard access.
The source does not change transactional email delivery, notification channels, or email contents.
The book-cover presentation change does not affect SIWE or any wallet-authentication path.
The source does not modify authentication requirements or information exposed through public APIs.
The reference to a book cover is visual and limited to the landing page; it does not affect book access or asset state after NFT transfer.
The landing-page book-cover cropping correction does not affect the deferred Transak fiat-minting flow.
The source concerns visual cropping of the cover on the landing page, not NFT metadata fields or their visibility.
The book-cover visibility correction does not alter automatic prize payout or any claim-flow behavior.
